text: In your Nordvale work you cut p95 latency from 900ms to 180ms. Walk me through the slow queries you found and the index changes you made.
guideline: Expects: EXPLAIN ANALYZE usage, composite index choice, N+1 elimination, connection pooling. Weak answer only names indexes without measurement.

text: You containerised all services with Docker for a partner-facing REST API. How did you handle zero-downtime migrations while the schema changed?
guideline: Expects: expand/contract migration strategy, backwards-compatible fields, deploy ordering, rollback plan. Weak answer: 'we ran migrations on deploy'.

text: Describe the Django models you owned at Nordvale and how you kept business logic out of views.
guideline: Expects: model layer, services/selectors pattern, serializers for validation. Weak answer: everything in views.
